Expand Cart Loading... eBay Home Shop by category All Categories Search Advanced breadcrumb eBay Books, Movies & Music Musical Instruments & Gear Guitars & Basses Parts & Accessories Books, Movies & Music Musical Instruments & Gear Guitars & Basses Parts & Accessories Effects Pedals Other Guitar Effects Pedals CURRENTLY SOLD OUT Boss FZ-3 Fuzz Guitar Effect Pedal 4.8 6 product ratings | About this product About this product Product Information The Boss FZ-3 Fuzz pedal is crafted as a successor of the Boss FZ-2. Sporting the Level, Tone and the Fuzz knobs, this Boss guitar effect pedal allows you to dial in the tone that he craves for. Having a simplified console, this Boss pedal doesn't have different distortion modes. Housed in a metal body, the Boss FZ-3 Fuzz is durable and refrains from regular wear and tear. The uniqueness of this Boss guitar effect pedal lies in the fact that it is not based on a single integrated circuit. The simplification of this Boss pedal is owed to the fact that an attempt has been made for the revival of the 60s vibe. Having the versatility to shake heaven of its foundations, the Boss FZ-3 Fuzz makes any guitar sound like you favorite band. Product Identifiers Brand Boss Model FZ-3 eBay Product ID (ePID) 78732683 Additional Product Features Current Draw 6mA Power Supply AC Adapter Type Fuzz Suitable For Guitar Electric Guitars Show More Show Less Ratings and Reviews Learn more 4.8 6 product ratings 5 5 users rated this 5 out of 5 stars 5 4 1 users rated this 4 out of 5 stars 1 3 0 users rated this 3 out of 5 stars 0 2 0 users rated this 2 out of 5 stars 0 1 0 users rated this 1 out of 5 stars 0 Would recommend Good value Enjoyable Most relevant reviews by nickbeatnik8 May 26, 2017 Machine Head Pedals rock I wasn't sure what I was getting with this modded pedal, but I like the standard FZ-3. I couldn't find out any info on the Machiine Head Pedals site so I emailed them to find out what the mods were. I got a long a detailed reply from Keith at Machine Head explaining exactly what he'd done to this pedal, removing filtering of both high and low frequencies to open up the EQ range, biasing it to act like a Fuzz Face, and a couple of other things. The end result is an awesome fuzz face, but in a Boss enclosure with the Boss buffer, so I can place it anywhere in my chain without impedance issues changing the tone and response. It sounds like a dynamic, open, phat Fuzz Face with a bit more gain and sustain on tap. Love it. Verified purchase: Yes Condition: Pre-owned by yashir123 Jul 05, 2017 Love that fuzz tone! A good deal for a Fz3, FGreat garage fuzz sounds. Thanks Phantom. Verified purchase: Yes Condition: Pre-owned by myoldmansabum Aug 30, 2016 Best Fuzz Pedal Of The 1990's This is an incredible fuzz. I've compared it side-by-side to my mid 90's Russian Big Muff and my Fulltone Soul Bender and was shocked at how it seemed to embody all of the best attributes of both. It won't cop either tone perfectly, it has it's own personality that has a bit of flavor from each. It's quickly become my go-to fuzz pedal. Get one before the Frusciante freaks drive the price up even further!!
